components.result: Actual native address arrays give complete four-outcome weak and mass instruments, an explicit uniform-address preparation and an archive-preserving SWAP reset. With fresh independent sources, arbitrary-reference half-diamond errors are at most 14*t^2/(81*N) for current spectrum {-1,0,1} and 349*t^2/(1296*N) for the mass round. Complete history, finite resource and preparation/control error budgets are retained. The exact mass trace is 5/18 and its common rate factor relative to the distinct native-pair preparation is 5/4. A two-parameter log-ratio Jacobian has nonzero determinant; common normalization cancels, fixed marginals leave a phase interval, and the unchanged muon ratio has a +9.833581 ppm residual against the frozen CODATA 2022 direct comparison value.

interface.state: Declared blank double load at port two and independently prepared uniform address pair each cycle; continuing three-state register and arbitrary untouched reference; old source retained in an exported archive.
interface.algebra: Two 60-address source spaces and the three-state register, with all four return projectors and full nonreturn Gram matrices.
interface.operation: Explicit preparation unitary, controlled weak or mass kick, inverse ticks, four-outcome readout and SWAP with a fresh independent source. No reset by deletion of the failure environment.
interface.clock: Supplied dimensionless kick time h=t/N; weak current spectrum {-1,0,1} has diameter two. No physical duration or mass-unit identification.
interface.refinement: Finite repeated fresh-source cycles and temporal N limit on this fixed register. Accumulated implementation/preparation error is N*(epsilon+eta), with source independence included in eta.

remaining: Fresh source, preparation/reset, analyzer and kick services are supplied architecture; their autonomous realization and a common physical energy clock remain open.
Diagonal stationary register states form a family; the growing exported archive is not a stationary full observer.
Dimensionless rate ratios and a retrospective experimental comparison do not establish physical pole masses, a GeV scale or a new eligible comparison.

components.result: A bounded classical observer reconstructs native pair distance from a known binary preparation and addressed coin/current records without access to working source loads. Exhaustive comparison covers all 3960 branches. The exact three-state quotient has stationary law (5/11,5/11,1/11); worst-case total-variation error first falls below 1/100 at 39 native attempts. The protocol retains every no-op and halts the source at tape capacity. Its retained logical registers use 298 bits, or 311 including the incoming packet.

interface.state: Known two-occupation binary preparation among all 66 source states, supplied to the observer as a label; arbitrary initial mixtures are covered by convexity.
interface.algebra: Classical native source and bounded logical record registers; distance is reconstructed from complete addressed records, not an arbitrary unknown quantum state.
interface.operation: Independent uniform choice among thirty addressed seams and a fair native coin; observer consumes each sequenced native coin/current record and detects malformed or missing records.
interface.clock: Every native attempt counts, including no-ops; source halts at declared record capacity.
interface.refinement: Exact finite history induction and rational 39-attempt relaxation on the fixed source. Program/geometry storage, physical hardware and a full distance-output tape have separate costs.

remaining: Known preparation and addressed uniform-seam scheduling are declared interfaces of an observer extension; the fixed original observer does not inherit them by relabelling.
No gauge-sector operator map, physical temperature or transfer to the coherent lepton source is established.

components.result: All 1296 states and 7776 complete repair-event branches of a closed two-face triangular cell obey an exact nonincreasing load-plus-register cost. Terminal classes and rational absorption probabilities give limiting occupied-face share 1007/13824 for the declared preparation. An exact 128-attempt interval has width below 5.86e-10. Every initial distribution has nonterminal probability at most 25^(-floor(n/32)), from the all-state finite survival law.

interface.state: Three loads in {0,...,5} and opposite face classes (k,-k) in Z6 on a declared two-face cell; the stated 1007/13824 average uses independent uniform loads in {0,...,5} and initial flux zero.
interface.algebra: Complete 1296-state classical law, all load-only, accepted-class and no-operation events; exact rational occupation statistics.
interface.operation: Native load repair and register class-acceptance functions with uniform choice of three oriented seams and a fair balancing coin.
interface.clock: Complete native attempt count; no physical temperature, duration or cooling schedule is inferred.
interface.refinement: Exact finite dynamics, absorbing-class limits and a uniform all-initial-state block contraction on this fixed cell; no spatial thermodynamic limit.

remaining: The closed cell is a supplied finite geometry; the result does not transfer its absorption probabilities to the full federation.
Persistent class occupation is not a physical particle identity, thermal abundance or cosmological epoch.
